Hanoi Larosa hotel is situated in the heart of Hanoi. It just takes a few steps to Tran Quy Cap railway station, about 5 minutes walk to Temple of Literature, 10 minutes walk to Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Old Quater , Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, and 45 minutes to Noi Bai Airport. Designed by European Classical architecture, 72 beautiful rooms are appointed with everything required to ensure your stay will be an enjoyable experience which includes complimentary hi-speed Internet. In order to easing your body and mind, Larosa Hotel boasts an elegant spa which has a range of unique treatments blending contemporary and ancient techniques. With more travelers wanting to maintain their exercise routines while on the road, the hotel also offers a fitness center equipped with latest equipment. The meeting room features a generous pre-function area and come complete with audio-visual equipment. Larosa ‘s restaurant and bar showcases an extensive menu, as well as daily buffet breakfast , in a cool and comfortable atmosphere. All in all, Larosa hotel is an ideal place for travelers whether you are visiting Hanoi for leisure or business.
